knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unknown status is a hazard until it is assessed. Age and speed do not show safety.
Dry-sweeping can create aerosols and dust. The other two are required steps.

practicalCriteria: On a diagram of a fictional scene, the learner marks each plausible exposure route and each uncertain area. Pass: at least three routes and one uncertain area are marked.
The learner names the evidence needed to resolve one uncertain area. Pass: the evidence is named and no sampling is described.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: An aerosol-producing task has no approved method.
Worker training or exposure controls are not verified.
